guard: Only resources carrying the exact Compose project label or exact installer name may be removed.
steps: Stop only the listener on port 4324 after exact Vite PID and command validation.
Remove only the exact installer container after llp0102.arm label validation.
Run Docker Compose down -v for the exact generated files and exact Compose project.
Remove only the three ignored arm-local runtime directories.
Probe all assigned ports and exact Compose-label resources against the empty baseline.
recovery: Removed local data is not recoverable; retained bootstrap, schema, and deterministic provisioning source recreate it.
